field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Yes (default): "Proceed to Checkout" and /checkout/ go to Zero Checkout. No: Magento's stock checkout is used instead; Braintree and offline payment methods work there, Stripe/Authorize.Net/PayPal Standard (Zero) are hidden.

field.label: Layout
field.comment: One page shows everything at once. Steps shows contact and addresses, then the shipping method, then payment, one at a time, with the order summary alongside; each step's fields are checked before the next. Without JavaScript the steps fall back to one page.

field.label: Address Autocomplete
field.comment: Suggests addresses as the shopper types the street; picking one fills street, city, region and postcode. Looked up by the server: no third-party script on the page, the key never reaches the browser. Google Places: needs an API key with Places API (New); fast. Photon: OpenStreetMap, no key, open source; run your own server for real traffic (the public one can take seconds per answer).

field.label: Photon Server URL
field.comment: The /api/ endpoint of a Photon server (github.com/komoot/photon).

field.label: Discount Code Field
field.comment: "Have a discount code?" in the order summary. The cart page's discount box is independent of this.

field.label: Order Comment
field.comment: Optional note from the shopper (up to 1000 characters). Saved on the order: Comments History in the admin order view, and the order page in the customer's account.

field.label: Sign In at Checkout
field.comment: "Already have an account? Sign in" for guests. Uses Magento's own sign-in (captcha, lockout, cart merge) and returns to checkout with the saved addresses.

field.label: Enable Terms and Conditions
field.comment: Magento's own setting (also under Sales > Checkout > Checkout Options). The agreements themselves are edited in Stores > Terms and Conditions; "Manually" ones become required checkboxes above Place Order, checked again on the server.

group.label: Payment Methods
group.comment: Payment methods are set up where Magento keeps them: Sales > Payment Methods (Stripe, Braintree, Authorize.Net and PayPal for Zero Checkout are there too).

group.label: Payment Webhooks
group.comment: Mollie, Klarna, Adyen, monobank and LiqPay tell the store about a payment with a webhook or callback. The store checks that the call is the provider's and about one of its orders, then brings the order in line with the provider.

field.label: Process Through the Queue
field.comment: Yes: the provider gets its answer at once; the consumer zero.checkout.webhook, which cron starts, updates the order (through RabbitMQ when env.php has queue/amqp, through the database queue otherwise; when the provider can't be asked, five tries, then a comment on the order). No: the order is updated while the provider waits for the answer.
